ruling.recommended_action: Escalate to Ryde Trust & Safety: preserve the full chat log and GPS trace, review the driver's threatening message under the Code of Conduct (Assault/harassment/threats clause) and consider account action; separately have a human confirm the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee (driver pressed "I'm Here" 09:50:45, GPS stationary within 200 m of Bugis Junction until cancellation 09:54:25 = 4m04s wait, so the fee appears valid) and inform the rider of the outcome via RydeHELP. Do not auto-adjudicate.
ruling.escalation_reason: Driver chat message at 2026-10-15T09:54:05+08:00: "Hurry up or I will find you and you will regret it." — contains a threat/intimidation keyword ("find you"), triggering SAFE-1. Additionally the dispute type is no_show while the rider's complaint rests on driver conduct; the fare question (driver-initiated cancellation 4m04s after pressing "I'm Here" with GPS within 200 m of Bugis Junction, i.e. an apparently valid NS-1 no-show fee of $6.61) is left to the human reviewer rather than auto-adjudicated. Recommend review of the driver's conduct under Ryde Code of Conduct, and of the rider account's no-show dispute history.
